feeds.title: Migrant Histories and Heritage Making Blog
feeds.description: This blog details the research developments and reflections relating to my project 'Making Migrant Heritage', which asks: How do communities across Australia engage with and interpret official heritage practices and language in order to make their migrant and settlement pasts public? The blog is managed by an Australian oral, public, and cultural historian. He has published information on child migration, multiculturalism and popular culture, migrant accommodation centers, and public history and heritage in Australia.

feeds.title: Southwark Heritage
feeds.description: Follow the Southwark Heritage Blog to learn more about History, stories, and heritage from Southwark Council's Cuming Collection and Archives. Southwark Archives is where they have gathered surviving documents, photographs and film to help preserve and share the range of Southwark's history, along with information on changes in Southwark today.

feeds.title: UCD Library Cultural Heritage Collections Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the UCD Library Cultural Heritage Collections blog. Discover and explore the historical treasures housed within our Archives, Special Collections, National Folklore

feeds.title: National Trust for Historic Preservation
feeds.description: The National Trust for Historic Preservation is leading the movement to save places where our history happened. They are a privately funded nonprofit organization that works to save America's historic sites; tell the full American story; build stronger communities; and invest in preservation's future. Follow their blog to learn in detail about their activities, latest projects, different historical places, and their importance.

feeds.title: World Heritage Centre
feeds.description: Heritage is our legacy from the past, what we live with today, and what we pass on to future generations. Our cultural and natural heritage is both irreplaceable sources of life and inspiration. WHC is at the forefront of the international community's efforts to protect and preserve. The blog cover all the news, updates, activities, and information regarding the world heritage sites.

feeds.title: The Heritage Alliance
feeds.description: Read the latest news, posts, articles, and jobs on their blog, showcasing independent heritage work and the biggest coalition of heritage interests in England. Established in 2002, the Heritage Alliance is a membership body, which represents the independent heritage movement in England. As such, it has a unique role, promoting the sector in all its diversity.

feeds.title: Archives Hub Blog
feeds.description: Use the Archives Hub to find unique sources for your research, both physical and digital. Search across descriptions of archives, held at over 380 institutions across the UK. It gives you great value as a way to quickly find archives held in the UK. It is a highly used and popular service. The Archives Hub blog provides information and opinions about current archival issues, as well as Hub news and updates

feeds.title: African Heritage
feeds.description: A blog about African legends, African problems, African diaspora, African history, and history of other countries and continents through audio and video files.

feeds.title: Glasgow City Heritage Trust Blog
feeds.description: Glasgow City Heritage Trust gives out almost £ 1 million in funding each year to help people in Glasgow protect, repair, and promote the city's historic buildings and places. Their heritage blog covers topics like The Risks of Fire in Historic Buildings, Post-War Housing Struggles, Understanding Ghost Signs, workshops, podcasts, and more.

feeds.title: European Heritage Tribune
feeds.description: The European Heritage Tribune is a young and independent digital news platform for the European heritage community. They strengthen the European network by sharing the news and distributing the knowledge by and for the heritage sector. They cover the news of Europe's cultural heritage as influenced by national and international politics, economy, policy, legislation, finance, climate change, digitization, tourism, and a lot more.

feeds.title: Our History, Our Heritage | The Maryland Historical Trust Blog
feeds.description: The Maryland Historical is dedicated to preserving and interpreting the legacy of Maryland's past and assists the people of Maryland in understanding their historical and cultural heritage. In their heritage blog they cover topics like Annapolis State House, Award announcements, events, the Montgomery County Emory Grove and more

feeds.title: Breadalbane Heritage Society Blog
feeds.description: The Breadalbane Heritage Society is based in Aberfeldy in the heart of Perthshire and was founded in 1962. Their aims are to promote interest in, research into, and study of archaeology, history, antiquities, folklore, natural history, especially of Breadalbane and the Upper Tay basin. Their heritage blog shares information about their heritage sites,research, study material, their visits and more.

feeds.title: Oregon Heritage Exchange
feeds.description: Oregon Heritage is a blog and a part of the Oregon Parks and Recreation Department that provides technical support and services to people and organizations documenting, preserving, interpreting, and sharing Oregon's heritage.

feeds.title: Heritage Discovered Blog
feeds.description: Heritage Discovered Blog helps people who want to learn more about their family, find answers and uncover stories about them. The author of the blog page believes that building your family tree isn't only about collecting names and dates. It's about discovering the little things that made your ancestors who they were.

feeds.title: London Remembers
feeds.description: The aim of this website is to document all the memorials in London. That's the plaques, monuments, statues, fountains, and that commemorate a person, an event, a building, and more. This website focuses on finding the memorials, photographing them, plotting them on a map, and logging them in a searchable database, thus providing a powerful research tool.

feeds.title: Heritage London Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Heritage London Foundation (HLF) is a non-profit organization dedicated to preserving and providing a use for heritage buildings in the City of London. Their blog provides articles such as the history of places, information on heritage sites, events, activities, and more.

feeds.title: The Historic England Blog
feeds.description: They are the public body that helps people care for, enjoy and celebrate England's spectacular historic environment. Their blog covers topics like Archaeology, Architecture, Conservation, First World War Heritage, climate change, Historic photography, and more.

feeds.title: ASI Heritage Blog
feeds.description: ASI is composed of a team of dedicated, diverse, and talented professionals working to provide the highest quality consulting services in cultural heritage conservation, planning, and management. Follow their blog to get updated about contests, generational threads, research, informational articles, field trips, and more.

feeds.title: The Heritage Journal
feeds.description: The Heritage Journal grew out of Heritage Action, a grassroots organization formed in 2003 by a large number of 'ordinary people caring for extraordinary places'. Its focus is on the conservation of prehistoric sites by promoting greater public appreciation of them and highlighting the many threats they face. It has grown into a very widely read community resource and everyone, whether professional or amateur, is welcome to contribute.

feeds.title: Oil Region Library Association
feeds.description: ORLA is dedicated to enriching the lives of our community, encouraging lifelong learning, and providing access to information and resources. The Oil City area's hidden heritage is one filled with ingenuity, largesse, culture and so much more. The city's incredible success was fueled by great wealth and exceptional talent. Association's blog provides all the necessary information about the city and all the things happening around it.

feeds.title: Reformation Heritage Books | The Heritage Blog
feeds.description: The Heritage Blog publishes articles from a Reformed, Puritan, and Biblical ethos and is hosted by Reformation Heritage Books. Their mission is to glorify God and to strengthen the Church through publication and distribution.

feeds.title: Travel World Heritage
feeds.description: Travel World Heritage blog gives you the real scoop on UNESCO World Heritage Site, the top ten styled travel list, and the travel economics tips you need to make your travel plans a reality. The blog is helpful for the people looking for places to travel and tips for traveling.

feeds.title: Heritage Mississauga Blog
feeds.description: Heritage Mississauga (Mississauga Heritage Foundation) began in 1960 when the then-Township of Toronto organized a citizens' group to move a heritage home that once belonged to a United Empire Loyalist family. Their blog provided information on Heritage Resource Centre, Public Exhibit Gallery, Outreach Presentations, publications, and many Heritage-themed Events.

feeds.title: Heritage Workshop
feeds.description: James Lesh is an urban historian specializing in heritage conservation. He is interested in the potential for history and heritage to enhance cities, places, and society. His blog heritage city is on urban history and heritage conservation.

feeds.title: Alabama Heritage
feeds.description: Alabama Heritage is an award-winning, quarterly, print magazine first published during the summer of 1986. The blog's mission is to educate, inspire, and entertain with stories of Alabama's history and culture with lively, colorful articles about the fascinating people, places, and events that helped shape Alabama and the South.

feeds.title: ICOMOS
feeds.description: ICOMOS, the International Council on Monuments and Sites, works for the conservation and protection of cultural heritage places. It is the only global non-government organization of this kind, which is dedicated to promoting the application of theory, methodology, and scientific techniques to the conservation of architectural and archaeological heritage. Its mission is to promote the conservation, protection, use, and enhancement of monuments, building complexes, and sites. The blog site provides all the necessary information about the organization and its work.

feeds.title: Southeast Asian Archaeology
feeds.description: Southeast Asian Archaeology blog about a Comprehensive site covers local news, academic research, opportunities, and useful resources. Dr. Noel Hidalgo Tan curates archaeology news about Southeast Asia Archaeology.

feeds.title: Heritage Auctions Blog
feeds.description: Heritage Auctions is the largest collectibles auctioneer as well as the largest auction house founded in the US. Their Mission is to be the world's most trusted and efficient marketplace and information resource for owners of fine art, jewels, rare collectibles, and other precious objects.
